messages:
maya (Support): FYI escalation from jazzshop-prod — multiple 400s on function/tool calling right after last runtime deploy. Customer reporting checkout errors and increased error budget. Repro + payload below.

maya (Support): Repro payload (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{
    "model":"redwood/serving-v2.3",
    "input":"Get price for SKU 123",
    "functions":[{
      "name":"pricing_lookup",
      "parameters":{
        "type":"object",
        "properties":{
          "sku":{"type":"string"}
        },
        "required":["sku"]
      }
    }],
    "function_call":{
      "name":"pricing_lookup",
      "arguments":"{\"sku\":123}"
    }
  }'
```

maya (Support): Response from runtime: `400 schema_validation_failed` 
Payload-level error in logs: `{\"error\":\"schema_validation_failed\",\"details\":\"sku: expected string, got number\"}`

lia (Customer Success): Customer saw ~1.2k errors in 10m window and some failed checkouts. They're asking for repro steps and ETA.

sam (Eng-Runtime): tagging @jordan — this smells like the function_call serialization change we merged in the v2.3 runtime. Quick question: was the customer using a client-side SDK that auto-serializes args as numbers? The logs imply the arguments arrived as JSON number rather than string.

jordan (Eng-ML): I pulled the failing CI job — `fncall_schema_suite` — and see a new regression after the model-serving change. Golden prompt expectations assumed `arguments` is a JSON string (escaped) for backward compat; the new runtime is passing parsed JSON in some codepaths. Failing test excerpt:
```
FAIL test_fncall_schema.py::test_pricing_lookup_escaping
Expected: arguments == '"{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"ABC123\\\"}"'
Actual: arguments == '{"sku":"ABC123"}'
```

sam (Eng-Runtime): Ok that explains mismatch. Two mitigation paths: 1) quick rollback to serving-v2.2 for the affected pools, or 2) force stringify on the function_call.arguments in the runtime to preserve previous behavior while we update schema tests and SDKs. Which do we prefer?

maya (Support): Customer wants immediate fix — rollback if low-friction. If rollback will take >30m, do the stringify hotfix and we can patch SDKs in follow-up. Lia, can you keep the customer updated?

lia (Customer Success): I told them we're investigating and will provide a 30m update. They'll accept a short rollback.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-293 created by maya — severity: high — tags: fncall, schema, customer-impact

sam (Eng-Runtime): I'll prepare a hotfix branch to stringify arguments and run quick smoke tests. @jordan can you run the failing golden prompt locally against the hotfix? If it passes, we can push and route traffic to patched nodes.

jordan (Eng-ML): On it. I have a reproducer harness — will validate against the `fncall_schema_suite` and the customer's payloads. Will post CI run id.

maya (Support): Adding the customer's sample event and request id to the incident. Also attaching a minimal repro test case so the QA team can add it to the golden prompts.

sam (Eng-Runtime): Quick note — also seeing a few cases where `function_call.name` selection falls back to a different tool (tool choice mismatch) when arguments parsing fails; that's probably due to our routing guard. I'll include a guard to keep tool selection stable on parse errors.

maya (Support): Awesome. Please paste rollback plan / hotfix PR link here when ready. I'll keep the customer thread updated. :thumbsup:

jordan (Eng-ML): CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/9834 — hotfix branch passes local suite, failing cases gone.

sam (Eng-Runtime): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/462 — hotfix adds stringify fallback and preserves prior behavior. Rolling to 25% canary now.

maya (Support): Canary looks good at 25% for jazzshop-prod. Error rate dropped to near 0. Lia, please confirm with customer.

lia (Customer Success): Customer confirmed reduced failures. They're okay with staged rollout and final rollback if anything else crops up.

maya (Support): Postmortem action items: add explicit fncall schema tests to `fncall_schema_suite`, include customer's sample as golden prompt, add an SDK note about argument typing, and add a gating CI check on runtime changes that touch function_call serialization.

ops-bot: Scheduled task created: `add-golden-pricinglookup` assigned to jordan, due 2026-04-02.

maya (Support): Thanks team. Closing loop once PR fully rolled out and CI back to green.
